evidence_catalog.text: Tracked Hailstorm Events from Radar Data (unique_tracks_90.csv)

This dataset contains tracked hailstorm events based on radar-derived maximum vertically integrated liquid (max_VIL). The dataset provides key storm parameters such as latitude, longitude, timestamp , and storm intensity. The dataset was generated as part of the study "Modulation of Severe Hailstorms in Alberta by Large-Scale Climate Teleconnections."
Radar, Hailstorms, Max_VIL, Storm Tracks, Climate, CSV, Alberta

notes: max_VIL is described as 'maximum vertically integrated liquid' in S2, which relates to precipitation intensity.
No explicit unit provided in evidence; max_VIL typically measured in kg/m^2 or mm but not in allowed_units list.
